description: Local-first, keyboard-first SSH workspace (terminal UI): ssh_config, known_hosts and ssh-agent as the source of truth, SFTP, tunnels, key management, snippets.
notes: Portico reads %USERPROFILE%\.ssh\config and the OpenSSH for Windows agent (\\.\pipe\openssh-ssh-agent).
Run `portico` in Windows Terminal. The desktop app is the NSIS installer of the release (see @REPO_URL@/blob/main/docs/RELEASE.md).
